messages.text:
Hello Bitforturn Support,

My Bitforturn B.1 (5.1 TH/s), order number Shop····, was delivered on
September 17, 2026.

The miner suddenly stopped working. The fan only moves slightly and stops,
and I noticed a burnt smell and black marks around the yellow power
connector on the miner.

I have disconnected it from power and have not attempted to turn it on
again.

I have attached photos of the connector and the affected area. Could you
please advise me on the warranty claim and repair or replacement options?

Thank you.
Handed to the team · RMA approval and dropship/Israel return route both need a person; return tooling

Hi,

Thanks for the photos and for disconnecting it straight away. That was exactly the right call, and please leave it unplugged.

Scorch marks and a burnt smell at the power connector are a hardware failure, not something to troubleshoot or power back on, so this goes through our warranty process rather than any home fix. Your order Shop···· shows the BS-1 delivered on September 17, which is well inside warranty, and the photos you sent are what the claim needs.

The B.1 didn't ship from our own warehouse, so the return route for your unit in Israel has to be set up specially rather than with a standard label. A colleague is picking that up today and will confirm the return and the replacement arrangement with you in this thread.

Nothing further is needed from you right now.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support
